description: Drive top-level mates to new positions — turn a revolute, slide a slider — and read them back; relations move the coupled mates too. Values are inches and degrees. Fails when Onshape does not apply a value, which it does silently for mates with limits enabled and for positions the rest of the assembly cannot reach.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

values.description: One entry per mate, naming only the degrees of freedom to change.

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_set_mate_values
title: Set mate values
